header.name: Intelligent Product Design Workshop
header.description:
The goal of this workshop style course is to help students move from TRL 3 ideas and Proof of Concepts to TRL 5/6 Industry relevant prototypes.

The students will be required to develop their proof of concept into an aesthetically pleasing, ergonomically sound, and user-friendly intelligent product.

The course builds upon courses like ESD/ PIS and reviews design concepts and teaches skills like Optimizing Bill of Materials, ensuring manufacturability and testability and repairability - aspects which are very important and relevant when moving from a PoC stage to a prototype stage.

The 8-10 week workshop is intended to be run in summer semesters with support from Centre for Intelligent Product Development (CiPD) and Industry Partners wherever needed.
prerequisites_desirable: The students should have done microcontroller programming and developed and demonstrated a proof of concept of an intelligent IoT product based on either Arduino, Raspberry Pi, STM32, ESP32 etc. platforms before registering for this course.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Develop understanding of Product Design constraints like - ergonomics, testability, repairability, alignment to standards, user interfaces, bill of materials, manufacturability etc.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Implement ideas and industrial design concepts to replicate existing PoC into a single-board prototype to develop better understanding of the Product Development process

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Critically evaluate prospective user inputs and expections and develop product specifications (including cost, life-of-product, servicability, repairability, upgradability, etc)

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Design a Prototype of the product by including industrial design concepts (targeting TRL 5/6).

lecture_topics: Introduction to industry standard microcontroller ecosystem
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Identify intelligent product idea to take taken forward to Prototype stage and demo at the end of the course

lecture_topics: Industry standard microcontroller and sensor ecosystems

lecture_topics: Design Optimization and Design - Reducing Bill of Materials
methods to ensure component availability to enable product servicing over expected life
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment:
Assignment-3: Define specifications of product

Assignment-4: Optimize Bill of Materials and do component selection based on product specification

lecture_topics: Key considerations of ergonomic and manufacturable design
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment:
Assignment-5: Design body of the product

Assignment-6: Design PCB in desired shape and fixtures etc
Lab: Design body of product

lecture_topics: Send PCB design for fabrication and assembly
Key considerations of good UI Design
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment:
Assignment-7: Develop app/ test plan etc

Assignment-8: UI Design and test
Lab: Final PCB design
Final Body Design

lecture_topics: Importance of Standards and alignment to Standards
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment:
Final Product Integration and demonstration
